identity.name: AEC Studio
identity.description: Surfaces AEC Studio's artifact publish queue inside KChat Desktop and ingests review-thread comments back into AEC Studio over its loopback HTTP API.

procedures.rationale: Read the review-thread messages the user opted in to share with AEC Studio so the bridge can mirror them back as ReviewComment rows on the Deliver page.
Enumerate conversations so the publish panel can show which thread the active project will publish into.
Post a queued AEC Studio artifact card (deliver-pack share, render bundle, BIM export) into the user-selected KChat thread.

views.title: AEC Studio Publish
views.description: Shows the AEC Studio artifact cards queued for the current thread, with one-click publish and a live count of review comments mirrored back into AEC Studio.
